table.name: TLGNR_CUSTORDER_STATUS_BS
table.description: The status of a customer order represents its current position in the customer order workflow. FIXME (romek Jul 12, 2011): To be updated with more detailed description.

column.name: CUSTORDER_STATUS_CD
column.description: PK. 1=new, 2=open, 3=finished. Although the states look fully sorted now, they should be treated as non-sortable, in case new states will be added at a later point in development. Comparisons with < and > are forbidden!

column.name: SORTING_NO
column.description: This is to DISPLAY all status codes in a 'natural' way to the user. It is forbidden to attach any process logic to this field! Currently custorder_status_cd is in natural order (the codes are arranged in ascending order), however new codes must be added to the end (in order not to break too much code/DB-Views), and therefore an explicit sorting_no is introduced.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
